title: Add-ons
summary: Every modifier customers picked: how often, what it earned, and its attach rate.

blocks.text: Add-ons lists every modifier customers chose (a spice level, an extra topping, a side): how often, the extra charged for paid ones, and the **attach rate**, how often it was picked per unit of the item it belongs to.
Add-on money is already inside the item's own sales. Don't add the two together.
